messages:
ana: Quick report from the workshop: the Next starter sample that uses a WebWorker to do embed batching is hitting an auth/retry edge where the worker's fetches never surface error to the main thread, leaving the UI spinner alive. Repro steps below.

ana: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-worker-starter (branch: worker-auth-leak). Steps: pnpm install && pnpm dev, open /playground, toggle 'worker batching' and click 'embed docs' twice fast. One of the parallel batches fails with 401; the worker retries but postMessage back to main never arrives due to worker-level abort handling.

tom: ugh. do we use the same SDK inside the worker? workers lack access to the usual token-refresh flow in DOM, so retries might loop.

ana: we initialize a lightweight fetch wrapper in the worker that uses the SDK's browser client via importScripts. It calls redwood.embed.batch() and on 401 triggers the SDK retry loop, but the worker swallows AbortError and doesn't forward the final failure event to main. result: main thinks request is pending indefinitely.

li: quick mitigation: main thread should set a per-request timeout in addition to relying on worker messages; for samples we can show a 12s fallback. But we should fix SDK/worker behavior so retries surface final error.

ana: minimal repro logs: 
```
worker: POST /v1/embeddings 401
worker-sdk: retry attempt 1
worker-sdk: retry attempt 2
worker: caught AbortError, returning undefined
main: waiting for worker message...
```

li: SDK action: add explicit worker compatibility doc and ensure the browser client exposes a .signal-aware path that forwards final error via throw rather than swallow. Also make retry logic configurable (maxAttempts) when used in Worker contexts.

tom: for the starter sample: update README to warn about worker retry semantics, add a small example wrapper that re-posts errors to main via postMessage, and include a tiny harness test that times out when worker doesn't reply within 10s.

ci-bot: Issue created: RED-DEVEX-4522 "Worker: SDK retries swallow final auth error causing UI hang in Next starter" (assignee: li).

ana: I'll open a patch to the sample that adds the fallback timeout and a reproducible test. li, can you propose the SDK change so we can sync PRs?

li: will draft a proposal today: add worker-safe retry mode + throw-on-final to browser client, and an env flag REDWOOD_SDK_WORKER_STRICT for samples.

ana: thanks ":thumbsup:". This should reduce a bunch of confusing workshop hangs.
